map.1 板英尺 ≈ 0.0023597 立方米（约 2359.7 cm³）。换算时总: 1 board foot ≈ 0.0023597 m³ (about 2359.7 cm³). In conversion, total board feet × 0.0023597 gives the volume in cubic metres.
map.BF = 1英寸厚×1英尺宽×1英尺长 = 144立方英寸: BF = 1 inch thick x 1 foot wide x 1 foot long = 144 cubic inches
map.MBF 即千板英尺（thousand board feet），是硬木贸易常用批量: MBF means thousand board feet, the common bulk unit of the hardwood trade. Total board feet ÷ 1000 gives MBF, which makes quoting and statistics on large timber orders easier.

map.为什么实际买到的板材比计算的小？: Why is the board I actually buy smaller than the calculation?
map.成本与库存估算：填入单价可预估一批木料费用，便于比价、预算与库存核算。: Cost and inventory estimate: enter the unit price to estimate the cost of a batch of timber, which helps with comparing quotes, budgeting and inventory accounting.
map.按板材长宽厚计算板英尺体积，支持多块合计与单位换算，用于木材用量与报价核算，纯前: Compute board feet from a board length, width and thickness, with support for multi-piece totals and unit conversion, for lumber quantity and quoting; fully front-end and exportable.
map.木材标称尺寸（如 1″×6″）是刨光前的毛尺寸，实际厚度与宽度更小；板英尺公式按: Nominal lumber dimensions (such as 1" x 6") are rough sizes before planing, so actual thickness and width are smaller; the board foot formula uses nominal dimensions, but stock and quotes may follow other conventions, so go by the seller spec sheet when purchasing.
map.木材采购与报价：按北美硬木惯例以板英尺（BF）计价，输入厚(英寸)×宽(英寸)×: Lumber purchasing and quoting: by North American hardwood convention pricing is in board feet (BF); enter thickness (in) x width (in) x length (ft) for one board, then multiply by quantity for the total volume.
map.材积单位换算：需在板英尺、立方米、立方英尺之间互转时，用换算模式一次性得到 m³: Volume unit conversion: when you need to move between board feet, cubic meters and cubic feet, the conversion mode returns m3 / ft3 / cm3 / MBF in one pass.
map.板英尺和立方米如何换算？: How do you convert board feet to cubic meters?
map.示例：1″×6″×8′ 松木板 10 根: Example: 10 pine boards of 1" x 6" x 8 ft
map.：单根板英尺 = 1 × 6 × 8 ÷ 12 = 4.00 BF；10 根总计: : single board foot = 1 x 6 x 8 / 12 = 4.00 BF; 10 boards total 40.00 BF. Conversion: about 0.0944 m3, 3.33 ft3, 0.0400 MBF. At $2 per BF the estimated cost is $80.00. Note: sellers usually price by nominal rather than actual planed dimensions, and drying grade and select grade affect the unit price.
